target: Author-library cross-check; original research figure not identified.
limitations: Agreement between two implementations is not agreement with a published optimized design. Internal pyMOTO filters/mass conventions must be aligned explicitly.

checks.scope: Objective, budget and every extra constraint at one smooth deterministic direction. Stress adaptive scale disabled only in the probe; eigenvalue reference and AL multipliers held fixed. Not certification at switches/repeated modes.
checks.library_probe_scope: Same random design and uniform-start objective references; both filters disabled; free-variable gradients only; native/foreign assembly, not a source-paper figure.

protocol: Existing engine loop; fresh final model evaluation after closing updater. Objective histories may be pre-update. Physical rows begin at y=0; 3D arrays are z,y,x. Diagnostic engine solves are additional to optimization. No source match implied.
next_check: Align a source heat design; keep cross-implementation value/gradient agreement separate from optimized paper-figure reproduction.

primary_source_review.scope: Existing installed module networks compared with independent native assembly on a common random field. Filters disabled and uniform-start eigenvalue normalization aligned. No published optimized figure reconstructed.
